messages.text:
Conditionally support the MAG-03/04/06 reallocation. I sent the assessment directly to the System Architect and coordinator.

Muon hosts remain geometrically compatible because the HCal outer boundary, outer coil and stepped muon envelopes stay unchanged.

The added HCal space does **not** yet establish improved filtering. Its eventual materials may change scattering, stopping, punch-through and magnetic fields; those effects need separate evaluation. Barrel/endcap transitions require the planned ray checks.

No files changed or sign-off granted.
